newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Sixteen drown in Pakistan boat accident.
newsitem.headline: Sixteen drown in Pakistan boat accident.

text.p: Sixteen people drowned after a boat capsized in a river in Pakistan's central province of Punjab, police said on Friday.
The police, quoted by the official news agency APP, said 11 bodies -- eight women, a teenage boy and two children -- had been recovered from the river Ravi after Thursday's accident.
They said five passengers were missing and presumed to have drowned when the boat capsized after hitting a bridge near the town of Nankana Sahib.
Thirty of the 46 passengers were rescued.
